title: Ancient Spartan doctor's treatise describing PTSD

tellings.quote: but we have archaeological evidence that goes all the way back to the Spartans. >> And there was a doctor that had written a treatise back then.

plain: In ancient Sparta, a doctor wrote a treatise describing the lasting mental harm of combat, what we now call post-traumatic stress disorder. A doctor named Greg Rogers, who has worked with NASA, says this from his own knowledge, as proof that war trauma has been recognised for thousands of years.
